method: Reduced CP1252 sources were entered into the VisuAlg editor and read back for equality before execution. Raw reference panel text was read through WM_GETTEXT and encoded as UTF-8. Desktop captures and operational details are retained privately.
purpose: Follow-up edge observations for the scoped fixes in PR #2; candidate fields still refer to the bootstrap binary, not the fixes.
limitations: Six reduced probes, not the complete corpus. Reference locale is en-US. UI notices and CRLF are preserved in raw text. The first output-edges relaunch failed before execution and is excluded; the successful rerun source and markers were verified. Bootstrap window discovery is not a conformance probe.
Published candidate diagnostic paths are reduced to filenames. Candidate stderr hashes describe the published redacted text. Desktop captures are not published.

probes.source:
algoritmo "output-edges"
inicio
  escreval("BEGIN:output-edges")
  escreval("N=[", -1, "][", -1.5, "]")
  escreval("Z=[", 0, "][", 0.0, "]")
  escreval("W0=[", 1:0, "][", 1.5:0, "]")
  escreval("W1=[", 123:1, "][", 1.5:1, "]")
  escreval("W5=[", -1:5, "][", -1.5:5, "]")
  escreval("D=[", 1.5:0:2, "][", -1.5:0:2, "]")
  escreval("I=[", 1:0:2, "][", 123:1:2, "]")
  escreval("S=[", "x":3, "][", verdadeiro, "][", falso, "]")
  escreval("END:output-edges")
fimalgoritmo
probes.referencePanelText:
Início da execução
BEGIN:output-edges
N=[ -1][ -1.5]
Z=[ 0][ 0]
W0=[ 1][ 1.5]
W1=[123][2]
W5=[   -1][   -2]
D=[ 1.5][ -1.5]
I=[ 1][123.00]
S=[x  ][ VERDADEIRO][ FALSO]
END:output-edges

Fim da execução.
probes.comparison: Default numeric and boolean spacing, zero-width decimal suppression, positive-width rounding, integer decimals, and string alignment.

algoritmo "output-rounding"
inicio

  escreval("R=[", 2.5:1, "][", -2.5:1, "][", 1.25:1:1, "][", 2.25:1:1, "]")
  escreval("B=[", verdadeiro:1, "][", falso:10, "][", verdadeiro:0, "]")
  escreval("S=[", "abc":1, "][", "abc":0, "][", "abc":5, "]")
  escreval("END:output-rounding")
fimalgoritmo
probes.candidateStdout:

B=[verdadeiro][     falso][verdadeiro]

probes.comparison: Decimal ties round away from zero. Reference then rejects the boolean field width on line 5; no completion notice.

probes.source:
algoritmo "for-edges"
var
  i: inteiro
inicio
  escreval("BEGIN:for-edges")
  para i de 5 ate 1 passo -2 faca
    i <- 100
  fimpara
  escreval("DOWN=[", i, "]")
  para i de 1 ate 6 passo 2 faca
    i <- 100
  fimpara
  escreval("STEP=[", i, "]")
  i <- 42
  para i de 3 ate 1 faca
    escreval("BAD")
  fimpara
  escreval("EMPTY=[", i, "]")
  para i de 1 ate 3 faca
    i <- 100
    escreval("BODY=[", i, "]")
    interrompa
  fimpara
  escreval("BREAK=[", i, "]")
  escreval("END:for-edges")
fimalgoritmo
probes.referencePanelText:
Início da execução
BEGIN:for-edges
DOWN=[ -1]
STEP=[ 6]
EMPTY=[ 3]
BODY=[ 100]
BREAK=[ 3]
END:for-edges

Fim da execução.
probes.candidateStdout:
BEGIN:for-edges
DOWN=[100]
STEP=[100]
EMPTY=[42]
BODY=[100]
BREAK=[100]
END:for-edges
probes.comparison: Normal completion, mutation, non-unit and negative steps, empty loop, and break with mutation.

algoritmo "for-termination"
var
  i: inteiro
inicio
  escreval("BEGIN:for-termination")
  para i de 5 ate 1 passo -2 faca
    escreva("D", i)
  fimpara
  escreval(";FINAL=", i)
  para i de 1 ate 6 passo 2 faca
    escreva("S", i)
  fimpara
  escreval(";FINAL=", i)
  para i de 1 ate 7 passo 3 faca
    escreva("T", i)
  fimpara
  escreval(";FINAL=", i)
  para i de 3 ate 1 passo -1 faca
    escreva("U", i)
  fimpara
  escreval(";FINAL=", i)
  para i de 1 ate 3 faca
    escreva("B", i)
    interrompa
  fimpara
  escreval(";FINAL=", i)
  escreval("END:for-termination")
fimalgoritmo
probes.referencePanelText:
Início da execução
BEGIN:for-termination
D 5D 3D 1;FINAL= -1
S 1S 3S 5;FINAL= 6
T 1T 4T 7;FINAL= 7
U 3U 2U 1;FINAL= 0
B 1;FINAL= 1
END:for-termination

Fim da execução.
probes.candidateStdout:
BEGIN:for-termination
D5D3D1;FINAL=1
S1S3S5;FINAL=5
T1T4T7;FINAL=7
U3U2U1;FINAL=1
B1;FINAL=1
END:for-termination
probes.comparison: Exact loop progression and exposed exit values without mutation.

algoritmo "for-break-mutation"
var
  i: inteiro
inicio
  escreval("BEGIN:for-break-mutation")
  para i de 1 ate 3 faca
    i <- -100
    interrompa
  fimpara
  escreval("LOW=[", i, "]")
  para i de 5 ate 1 passo -2 faca
    i <- 100
    interrompa
  fimpara
  escreval("DOWNHIGH=[", i, "]")
  para i de 5 ate 1 passo -2 faca
    i <- -100
    interrompa
  fimpara
  escreval("DOWNLOW=[", i, "]")
  i <- 42
  para i de 1 ate 3 passo -1 faca
    escreval("BAD")
  fimpara
  escreval("EMPTYDOWN=[", i, "]")
  escreval("END:for-break-mutation")
fimalgoritmo
probes.referencePanelText:
Início da execução
BEGIN:for-break-mutation
LOW=[ -100]
DOWNHIGH=[ 1]
DOWNLOW=[ -100]
EMPTYDOWN=[ 1]
END:for-break-mutation

Fim da execução.
probes.candidateStdout:
BEGIN:for-break-mutation
LOW=[-100]
DOWNHIGH=[100]
DOWNLOW=[-100]
EMPTYDOWN=[42]
END:for-break-mutation
probes.comparison: Break exposes the body value capped at the terminal bound, independent of step direction; empty descending loop exposes its initial value.
